title: Enquiry
description: A fostering enquiry as it moves from first contact towards application. v0.1 draft. The record is deliberately pseudonymous: it carries no name, contact details or full postcode, so it can be shared for analysis without identifying the person.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record follows.

enquiry_id.description: Identifier unique within the publishing service. Must not be derived from personal data.

received_at.description: When the enquiry was received, ISO 8601 with time zone.

source.description: How the person heard about fostering with this service, in the service's own words or a campaign tag.

intent_tier.description: What the person said would help most. Chosen by the enquirer, never inferred.

fostering_interests.description: Types of fostering the person asked about, if any.

postcode_outward.description: Outward part of the UK postcode only (for example 'M14'). The full postcode is never stored in this record.

la_gss_code.description: ONS GSS code of the local authority the enquiry was routed to.

front_door_id.description: Identifier of the front door that received the enquiry, from register/front-doors.csv.

preferred_contact_window.description: When the person asked to be contacted.

lawful_basis.description: UK GDPR lawful basis the service relies on to handle the enquiry.

marketing_consent.description: Separate, optional consent to newsletters or marketing. Never a condition of enquiring.

acknowledged_at.description: When an acknowledgement (on screen, email or SMS) was sent.

first_contact_attempt_at.description: When a person at the service first tried to reach the enquirer.

first_contact_made_at.description: When a two-way conversation first took place. An enquiry with this field set is a 'qualified enquiry'.

closure_reason_code.description: Why the enquiry ended. Provisional vocabulary; see schema/README.md.

recontact_after.description: Date the person asked to be contacted again, if they said 'not now'.
